name: Gossamer
description: Spin a web in a moonlit garden and catch the night's visitors. Solo or up to four.

controls.action: Walk the silk; hold S to drop on a line
Cast a thread to a twig or thread
Quick Orb; R spins the last again
Hold to wrap prey, tap to eat

help: Spin a web where the prey fly (the notebook's forecast tells you the night), then feel for what lands. Sticky silk catches, dry silk is strong. Wrap a catch before it tears free and eat it before dawn: meet the quota or lose an egg sac. Hide from the wren's shadow and from wasps in the leaves. Spend moult on upgrades between nights. Ten nights make a season.

badges.name: Orb Complete
badges.description: Close a spiral all the way round.

badges.name: Perfect Radials
badges.description: Spin eight or more radials by hand, evenly spaced.

badges.name: Beetle Buster
badges.description: Eat a beetle without losing a frame or radial thread.

badges.name: Wasp Slayer
badges.description: Beat three wasps as the jumping spider.

badges.name: Daily Weaver
badges.description: Spin a night in the daily garden.

badges.name: Silk Donor
badges.description: Give a friend a hundred silk.

badges.name: Dew Master
badges.description: Shake twenty dew beads off your web.

badges.name: Driven Off
badges.description: Send the mantis away on the last night.
